limitations: Front-view photographs only; the benchmark does not contain profile views.
The benchmark includes Asian and Caucasian faces but does not represent all populations.
Ratings reflect the benchmark raters and are not universal or objective attractiveness labels.
The dataset and derived use are restricted to non-commercial research unless permission is obtained.
percentileDefinition: Empirical percentile of the predicted 1–5 rating within all 5,500 SCUT-FBP5500 mean human ratings.

reportedEvaluation.note: Metrics reported by the AttractiveNet repository on its held-out SCUT-FBP5500 test split.
